dct_title_s: [Chart showing locations] of cash and carry ice stations by wards
dct_alternative_sm: [Chart showing locations] of cash and carry ice stations by wards
dct_description_sm: Map of Minneapolis, hand-marked with ward numbers and locations of ice stations.; Relief shown pictorially.; Shows railroads, trolley lines, streets, parks, schools, and businesses.; A portion of the upper right corner of the map is missing.; Areas of the base map have been updated with pasteover slips.; Marked in pencil on map recto and verso: "1601 / 202"; "[Base map published] by McGill-Warner Co., St. Paul, Minn."; "March 1929."
